lines: Bear  Badger  Elk.  Ant[?].  Blk.  Wht.  Hare
handwriting.note: Game tally. Column headings written by TR; Wht. and Hare sit in the printed Dolls./Cts. columns. Fourth heading looks like 'Cnt.'/'Clnt.', probably 'Ant.' (antelope). Row labels '11)' and '111)' (perhaps II and III; second has an extra joined stroke). Struck Bear figure in row 11) is a 2/3 overwritten and crossed out. 'Bighorn' is written across the Elk/Ant columns as a row label (place or trip name, not a count). '36' is the grand total written large under a bracket (placed in the Ant. column only for layout). Column totals check: Bear 3, Badger 1, Elk 6, Ant 2+1=3, Blk 5+3=8, Wht 2+1+1=4 (the 4 written over another figure, possibly 8), Hare 1+4+5+1=11; sum 36. Cell alignment approximate.
Summary at the foot of the page, figures separated by long slanting strokes: Bear 3, Badger 1, Elk 6, deer (Ant+Blk+Wht = 3+8+4) 15, Hare 11.
